key_reasoning.reason: Diffstat reports 11 files, which maps to XL by the file-count rule. Only 2 are source (session-project.ts, forwarder.ts), 5 are tests and 4 are docs (architecture doc plus task artifacts), so the real implementation footprint is far smaller. The score is mechanical; it does not reflect implementation effort, and the total stays in the S band either way (an M score would give 12).

M, not higher. The change sits in the project-name binding policy (decideProject, isSendableProjectName) and header-value safety: a non-ASCII name would be corrupted as Latin-1 by fetch/undici. The pattern already exists in the same module and is extended rather than invented. Binding now depends on name order ([Be] alone conflicts, [Be, A] binds A), and the forwarder adds a bounded per-session WARN set (MAX_WARNED_SESSIONS) that never logs the name. Edge-case coverage was added in the existing forwarder, tick-processor, session-project, spool-io and project-interleave test files, so no uncovered defensive pattern remains.
